title: Gallery scroll lag: the per-scroll stop-sweep re-seeks every video
description: _stopOtherGalleryMedia runs on every scroll event and used to pause+seek+re-mute every video unconditionally. Blink does not short-circuit a seek to the current position, so an idle gallery took thousands of frame-0 decodes per second while scrolling. Guarded with an already-stopped early-out.
